source_title: Data from upward looking Acoustic zooplankton and fish profiler (AZFP) deployed on drifting sea ice in the Arctic during MOSAiC expedition
catalog_and_document_scope: The publisher calls the instrument upward-looking. Two byte-identical XMLs name serial 55171, four nominal frequencies and multiple sampling phases; two DPLs were also extracted. No acoustic member or certificate was obtained.
metadata_conflicts: DPL says Average Burst Pings yes while XML AverageBurstPings is 0; format semantics require a raw-header check.
DPL/XML frequency metadata use Hz labels with 38/125/200/455 values; units require confirmation.
Sampling phases include 15-second and 4-second periods and zero pulse-length configurations; no homogeneous full-deployment assumption is permitted.
reviewer_disposition: Bounded metadata probe accepted; companion source not approved for calibrated processing or bulk acquisition.
